nehru-nagar.overview: Nehru Nagar is Bhilai's principal commercial and residential hub, a short distance from the Bhilai Steel Plant (SAIL) township that the city grew up around. It offers a mix of independent houses, mid-rise apartments, and active retail markets, serving both steel-plant employees and the broader twin-city (Bhilai–Durg) population.
nehru-nagar.connectivity: Close to NH 53 and NH 6, with Bhilai and Durg railway stations both within a 15–20 minute drive; Raipur's Swami Vivekananda Airport is roughly 40–45 minutes away.
nehru-nagar.socialInfra: Schools: Delhi Public School Bhilai, BSP schools network. Hospitals: Sector 9 Hospital (BSP), Chandulal Chandrakar Memorial Hospital. Retail: Nehru Nagar market, Junwani Road retail belt.
nehru-nagar.techParks: Bhilai's core employment driver is the Bhilai Steel Plant (SAIL), one of India's largest integrated steel plants, along with ancillary manufacturing units in the surrounding industrial belt.
nehru-nagar.upcomingInfra: Road and civic upgrades tied to the Bhilai–Durg urban agglomeration's Smart City initiatives, alongside continued expansion of the industrial belt along NH 53.

priceTrend.comparisonNote: Prices track steadily with steel-plant employment stability rather than sharp speculative growth.

rentalYield.note: Reliable rental demand from Bhilai Steel Plant employees and ancillary industry workers.

faq.q: Is RERA registration mandatory for projects in Bhilai?
faq.a: Yes, Bhilai falls under CG-RERA (Chhattisgarh Real Estate Regulatory Authority), the same as the rest of the state. Confirm any project's registration number on the CG-RERA portal before paying a booking amount.

faq.q: What is the average price per sq.ft. in Nehru Nagar, Bhilai?
faq.a: Around ₹2,800 per sq.ft. as of this update, with roughly 5% year-on-year growth, reflecting Bhilai's steady, industry-anchored property market.

faq.q: Why does Bhilai's property market depend so much on the steel plant?
faq.a: Bhilai grew as a planned township around the Bhilai Steel Plant (SAIL), and a large share of housing demand still comes from plant employees and related ancillary industries, which makes local employment trends a key indicator for this market.

faq.q: What should I verify before buying property near the BSP township area?
faq.a: Some housing near the plant is on leasehold/township land rather than freehold — confirm whether the property is freehold or leasehold, check the title and any transfer restrictions, and verify the encumbrance certificate before proceeding.
